# Quarantined trusted external reference data

Original numerical files are preserved byte-for-byte. They are not merged into the supplied synthetic dataset, residual training or laboratory histories.

- Zenodo6340016: Havunen, Passon, Hällström, Meisner and Schlüterbusch, cable-effects/divider data, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.6340016. **CC BY 4.0**. Measured divider step responses; unsuitable as complete LI/SI labels.
- Zenodo8435957: Hällström and collaborators, Linearity Extension of UHV Class Lightning Impulse Dividers up to 3000 kV, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.8435957. **CC BY 4.0**. Divider calibration/charging results, not per-shot generator training data.
- Zenodo20539246: Guo, Lili, Observation and statistical analysis data for positive leader branching in long air gaps, https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20539246. **CC BY 4.0**. Figure 2 voltage data; header units and complete hardware mapping were not established; excluded from fitting/scoring.
- Mendeley6g9cccrvvc: Jana, Suman (2019), Single level impulse generator, https://doi.org/10.17632/6g9cccrvvc.1. Public metadata only. Describes simulated Lightning data; not measurements.

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Each source retains its original metadata, attribution and file-checksum/provenance record. No endorsement is implied. No original data were modified; testing converts the metrology step’s seconds/volts to microseconds/kilovolts without recovering generator voltage. Detailed eligibility: docs/trusted_waveform_data_search.md and artifacts/external_data/source_review.json.
